raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Depends on #42423 (this branch is stacked on it; review the last four commits) and on #44260 (the FLUX CFG-weight check below reads `true_cfg_scale` through it).

## Motivation

Under FLUX.1 true CFG, Spectrum forecasts drift far from the real features from the first predicted step (relative L2 0.27-0.52 at step 5 on FLUX.1-dev), and even one final-step forecast left border artifacts in held-out images. CFG gating that freezes the cond-minus-uncond difference for most of the run also drifts with every reused step.

## Modifications

- FLUX.1 true CFG, CFG weight <= 2: Spectrum follows a bounded schedule. Real forwards for the first 40% of the steps and the last 2, and a real forward every other step in between (window 2, no growth). Other request Spectrum parameters are kept, and request-owned params are not mutated.
- FLUX.1 true CFG, CFG weight > 2: Spectrum is disabled for the request. The model returns no Spectrum context, so no forecaster is built and the request runs the uncached path. The log says which applies, once per request.
- `SpectrumParams.final_real_steps` (default 0, no CLI flag) keeps the final steps real; the FLUX policy sets it to 2.
- CFG gating may reuse the frozen delta for at most the final step on FLUX.1 and the final 5 steps on Wan (`cfg_gate_max_reused_steps`; all Wan variants inherit it). An earlier gate is moved later with a warning. Gating stays off by default.
- `spectrum.mdx`: FLUX.1 true CFG schedule with measurements, and the Wan gating cap.

## Accuracy Tests

Unit: `test_spectrum_lifecycle.py`, `test_cfg_gating.py`: 19 passed, 61 subtests (bounded schedule at CFG 1.5/2.0, disabled above 2 with no forecaster built, `final_real_steps`, Wan cap including explicit-disable and CFG-parallel cases).

FLUX.1-dev, 1024x1024, guidance 3.5, true CFG 1.5 and 2.0, 28 and 50 steps, 15 prompts x 2 seeds, compared with the same requests without Spectrum (B200). The gate was fixed before the run: median PSNR >= 27 dB per configuration, LPIPS <= 0.12 for every sample, and every image inspected.

| true CFG, steps | median PSNR, 1 GPU | max LPIPS, 1 GPU | median PSNR, 2 GPU CFG parallel | max LPIPS, 2 GPU |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.5, 28 | 29.13 dB | 0.114 | 29.13 dB | 0.098 |
| 1.5, 50 | 31.64 dB | 0.066 | 31.59 dB | 0.058 |
| 2.0, 28 | 28.24 dB | 0.114 | 28.24 dB | 0.104 |
| 2.0, 50 | 30.78 dB | 0.058 | 30.33 dB | 0.062 |

- The 9 prompts and the seed not used to choose the schedule give 29.1-31.6 dB median.
- All 240 image pairs were inspected, plus full-resolution corners of the worst three: no artifacts. Differences are composition, texture or small details, sometimes a different but plausible element (for example, a paved surface instead of asphalt).
- At true CFG 4 the Spectrum output is bit-identical to the uncached output (15/15).
- Re-checked after merging current `main` (`c82e8bd5fe`) together with #44260: 36 requests (true CFG 1.5/2.0 x 28/50 steps x 4 prompts, plus true CFG 4 on 2 prompts) are bit-identical to the acceptance outputs above.

Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B at its defaults (480x832, 81 frames, 50 steps), mean frame PSNR against no CFG gating:

| `cfg_gate_step` | guidance 3.0 | guidance 5.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.3 (35 reused steps) | 30.1-31.2 dB | 23.4-27.2 dB |
| 0.7 (15 reused steps) | 40.2-42.1 dB | 34.2-37.3 dB |
| 0.9 (5 reused steps, the new cap) | 46.1-47.1 dB | 40.7-42.8 dB |

The error grows smoothly with the number of reused steps, so the cap bounds an approximation rather than working around a bug.

End-to-end check of the cap on the real model (same defaults, guidance 3.0, seed 42, this branch): `cfg_gate_step` 0.3 and 0.7 each log `limits CFG residual reuse to the last 5 step(s) ... effective gate 45/50`, and their frames are bit-identical to an explicit 0.9; PSNR against the ungated run is 46.05 dB.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

FLUX.1-dev, 1024x1024, one B200 with no other process on it during the run, 2 warmups + 5 measured requests per case, alternating order:

| true CFG, steps | without Spectrum | Spectrum | speedup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.5, 28 | 5.24 s | 3.84 s | 1.36x |
| 1.5, 50 | 9.37 s | 6.92 s | 1.35x |
| 2.0, 28 | 5.26 s | 3.86 s | 1.36x |
| 2.0, 50 | 9.38 s | 6.93 s | 1.35x |

The schedule runs about 72% of the DiT forwards.

Limitations: validated only at true CFG 1.5 and 2.0, 1024x1024, 28 and 50 steps on FLUX.1-dev; the Wan cap was measured on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B only. The quality gate is perceptual, not bit-exact: with Spectrum on, the same seed gives a slightly different image.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

### Update (2026-10-15)

Merged the updated #42423 (which carries current `main`); no conflicts. On the new head: `test_spectrum_lifecycle.py` and `test_cfg_gating.py` 19 passed, 61 subtests passed; `pre-commit run --all-files` passes twice. Real runs on a B200 with this branch plus #44260 on current `main`:

- FLUX.1-dev: 36 requests (true CFG 1.5/2.0 x 28/50 steps x 4 prompts, plus true CFG 4 on 2 prompts) are bit-identical to the acceptance outputs above.
- Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B at its defaults: `cfg_gate_step` 0.3 and 0.7 both log the cap warning with effective gate 45/50 and give frames bit-identical to an explicit 0.9; PSNR against the ungated run is 46.06 dB. The frame hashes differ from the previous run on the older base (the base changed, and GPU kernels need not be bit-reproducible across code versions), but the PSNR agrees to 0.001 dB.

@@ -36,6 +36,35 @@ sglang generate \
 
 ## Advanced controls
 
+### FLUX.1 with true CFG
+
+When FLUX.1 evaluates separate positive and negative branches (true CFG),
+forecasts from early steps drift far from the real features, so Spectrum follows
+a bounded schedule up to a CFG weight of 2: real forwards for the first 40% of
+the steps and the last 2, and a real forward every other step in between. Above
+2, Spectrum is disabled for the request and every step runs a real forward. The
+log reports which one applies.
+
+On FLUX.1-dev at 1024x1024 (guidance 3.5, true CFG 1.5 and 2.0, 28 and 50
+steps, 15 prompts, 2 seeds, one B200), the bounded schedule ran about 72% of the
+DiT forwards and was 1.35x faster than the same requests without Spectrum.
+Against those requests the median PSNR was 28.2–31.6 dB and LPIPS stayed at or
+below 0.114, with or without CFG parallelism. The differences are changes in
+composition, texture or small details, sometimes a different but plausible
+element (for example, a paved surface instead of asphalt); no artifacts were
+visible.
+
+FLUX.1 also limits CFG gating to at most the final step. For example, requesting
+`cfg_gate_step=0.3` with 20 steps uses real negative-branch predictions for the
+first 19 steps. Residual refreshes use real positive and negative predictions
+and update both Spectrum histories. CFG-parallel requests still disable gating.
+
+Both remain approximations. Compare outputs against your uncached baseline and
+measure latency with diagnostics disabled. FLUX.1 without true CFG and the other
+supported models retain their existing Spectrum schedules.
+
+### Parameter reference
+
 Use `--enable-spectrum` explicitly. Providing any Spectrum override also
 enables it, but that implicit behavior is intended for scripts rather than new
 commands.
@@ -56,3 +85,35 @@ commands.
 These controls trade speed against output fidelity. Change one control at a
 time and retain a lossless baseline for comparison.
 </Warning>
+
+## Combining with CFG gating
+
+CFG gating (`--cfg-gate-step F`; `1.0`, the default, turns it off) is a
+separate lossy option. After fraction `F` of the steps it skips the
+unconditional forward and reuses the conditional-minus-unconditional difference
+frozen at that step, so the guidance term stops following the trajectory. Its
+error grows with the number of reused steps and with the guidance scale.
+
+With both enabled, every step before the gate runs real forwards on both
+branches, so the frozen difference never contains a Spectrum forecast. Spectrum
+therefore cannot skip those steps, and the combination is slower than Spectrum
+alone without being more accurate. On Wan, use Spectrum alone.
+
+Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B at its defaults (480x832, 81 frames, 50 steps, guidance 3.0),
+seed 42, two prompts, one B200, compared with the same request run without
+acceleration (latency from single runs, indicative only):
+
+| Setting | Mean frame PSNR | Mean LPIPS | Latency |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| None | — | — | 60 s |
+| `--enable-spectrum` | 26.8–27.6 dB | 0.08–0.10 | 19 s |
+| `--cfg-gate-step 0.3` | 30.1–31.2 dB | 0.02–0.03 | 39 s |
+| Both of the above | 28.5–30.3 dB | 0.05–0.06 | 25 s |
+| `--cfg-gate-step 0.7` | 40.2–42.1 dB | 0.003–0.005 | 51 s |
+| `--cfg-gate-step 0.9` | 46.1–47.1 dB | 0.001 | 57 s |
+
+At guidance 5.0 the accelerated settings lose another 1–7 dB.
+
+Wan therefore caps gating at the last 5 steps: an earlier gate is moved to step
+`num_steps - 5` with a warning, so at 50 steps `--cfg-gate-step 0.3` and `0.7`
+run as `0.9`. The 0.3 and 0.7 rows above were measured without the cap.

+            warmup_steps=2, window_size=4.0, flex_window=0.5, m=1, history_size=8
+        )
+        self.server_args = SimpleNamespace(enable_cfg_parallel=False)
+        server_args_patch = patch(
+            "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.server_args.get_global_server_args",
+            return_value=self.server_args,

+        self.addCleanup(server_args_patch.stop)

+    def _forward(
+        self, model, step, features, *, negative=False, do_cfg=True, cfg_scale=None

+        batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            enable_spectrum=True,
+            spectrum_params=self.params,
+            do_classifier_free_guidance=do_cfg,
+            is_cfg_negative=negative,
+            num_inference_steps=8,
+            debug=True,
+            guidance_scale=cfg_scale,
+        )
+        with set_forward_context(step, None, forward_batch=batch):
+            actual_forward = model.begin_spectrum_step()
+            if actual_forward:
+                model.spectrum_record_features(features)
+                return True, features
+            return False, model.spectrum_predict_features(torch.zeros_like(features))
+
+    def test_cfg_ranks_initialize_the_same_skip_schedule(self):
+        """A negative-only rank must use the configured window from its first request."""

+                    positive_real, positive_output = self._forward(
+                        positive, step, features

+                    negative_real, negative_output = self._forward(
+                        negative, step, features, negative=True
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(positive_real, negative_real)
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(positive_output, negative_output)
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        positive._get_spectrum_branch_state(),
+                        negative._get_spectrum_branch_state(),
+                    )
+                    decisions.append(negative_real)
+                self.assertIn(False, decisions)
+                # Each rank runs one forward per step, so both wrap after the run.
+                self.assertEqual(negative._get_spectrum_branch_state(), (0, 0, 4.0))

+    def test_reused_model_matches_fresh_model_after_request_restart(self):
+        """Completed and interrupted requests must not leak forecasts or debug stats."""
+        for prefix, negative, do_cfg, parallel in (
+            ("wan", True, True, True),
+            ("wan", False, True, False),
+            ("wan", False, False, False),
+            ("flux", True, True, True),
+            (SHARED, False, False, False),
+            (SHARED, True, True, True),
+        ):
+            for previous_steps in (7, 8):
+                with self.subTest(
+                    prefix=prefix,
+                    negative=negative,
+                    do_cfg=do_cfg,
+                    parallel=parallel,
+                    previous_steps=previous_steps,
+                ):
+                    self.server_args.enable_cfg_parallel = parallel
+                    reused = _SpectrumModel(prefix)
+                    for step in range(previous_steps):
+                        self._forward(
+                            reused,
+                            step,
+                            torch.full((2, 3), float(step + 20)),
+                            negative=negative,
+                            do_cfg=do_cfg,
+                        )
+                    previous_forecaster = reused._get_spectrum_forecaster()
+                    fresh = _SpectrumModel(prefix)
+                    for step in range(8):
+                        # A new shape also makes stale history fail immediately.
+                        features = torch.full((3, 4), float(step + 1))
+                        actual, output = self._forward(
+                            reused, step, features, negative=negative, do_cfg=do_cfg
+                        )
+                        expected_actual, expected_output = self._forward(
+                            fresh, step, features, negative=negative, do_cfg=do_cfg
+                        )
+                        self.assertEqual(actual, expected_actual)
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected_output)
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            reused._get_spectrum_branch_state(),
+                            fresh._get_spectrum_branch_state(),
+                        )
+                        separate = negative and reused._spectrum_supports_cfg_cache
+                        suffix = "_negative" if separate else ""
+                        for stat in (
+                            "real_steps",
+                            "skipped_steps",
+                            "shadow_rel_l2_sum",
+                            "shadow_rel_l2_count",
+                        ):
+                            attribute = f"spectrum_{stat}{suffix}"
+                            self.assertEqual(
+                                getattr(reused, attribute), getattr(fresh, attribute)
+                            )
+                        forecaster = reused._get_spectrum_forecaster()
+                        self.assertIsNot(forecaster, previous_forecaster)
+                        self.assertEqual(

+    def test_shared_cfg_state_is_not_reset_twice(self):
+        """A shared counter and history must retain both serial step-zero forwards."""
+        model = _SpectrumModel(SHARED)

+    def test_flux_cfg_gating_keeps_cond_schedule(self):
+        """Dropping the uncond forward after the gate must not shift cond decisions."""
+        gate_step = 3
+        gated, ungated = _SpectrumModel("flux"), _SpectrumModel("flux")
+        for step in range(8):
+            for negative in (False, True):
+                features = torch.full((2, 3), float(step + (10 if negative else 1)))
+                expected = self._forward(ungated, step, features, negative=negative)
+                if negative and step >= gate_step:
+                    continue  # CFG gating reuses the cached cond-uncond delta
+                actual, output = self._forward(gated, step, features, negative=negative)
+                if not negative:
+                    self.assertEqual(actual, expected[0], f"step={step}")
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected[1])
+        gated.spectrum_is_cfg_negative = False
+        # The cond counter saw one forward per step and wrapped at the end.
+        self.assertEqual(gated._get_spectrum_branch_state(), (0, 0, 4.0))
+        self.assertEqual(gated.spectrum_skipped_steps, ungated.spectrum_skipped_steps)
